title: BetterVanillaWood+
description: Better Vanilla Wood+ is a alpha resource pack that enhances Minecraft’s original wooden textures with a brighter, cleaner, and more stylized look.(This is my first resource pack, released as an early alpha while I develop the full wood set.)
body:
Better Vanilla Wood+ is an alpha-stage resource pack that reimagines Minecraft’s wooden blocks with a cleaner, brighter, and more stylized look.
This early version introduces a new visual direction for the game’s wood set, focusing on smoother details, improved color harmony, and a more modern feel while staying close to the vanilla identity.
More wood types and refinements will arrive as the project evolves.

* (This is my first resource pack project, currently in its early alpha stage. I’m experimenting with a new visual style and improving it step by step based on feedback.)
